caption: Gauges - the session on three needles
Shuffle - a new game every two minutes
Zone Row - the piece as one instrument
River Explorer - a river that forks where you steer
Stroke Coach - the shape of your drive, scored
Zombie Run - the horde is right behind you
Row Runner - rowing sets the pace, the runner jumps itself
Coast Flight - the California coast on a real globe
Skyline - every strong stroke drops another floor
Wave Rider - hold the pocket, not the throttle
Rocket Launch - hold the power or you never leave the pad
Canyon - fly the rings at the speed they ask for
Canyon Drive - the same canyon at ground level
Mega Pull - one big pull at the fairground
Race - rivals that row to your own average
Crew Boat - eight in time, and the swing is yours to hold
Regatta - one ranked race a day
Daily Row - a different challenge every day
Night Grid - your watts light the town
Head Race - 2,000 m against three crews on the clock
Tug of War - heave on every stroke
Collector - change lanes by changing pace
